uncertain_terms.note: The source document is largely in English already (mixed Arabic headings and English body); the English source text is kept verbatim and only the Arabic parts were translated. The manifest language 'ar' is therefore only partly accurate.
Header table reads 'القوة المحطة' / 'التقنية الإجراء' – garbled; rendered as 'Power Station' / 'Technical Procedure' by inference from the MPIS header pattern.
Source 'on an annually bases' kept verbatim; 'bases' is presumably a typo for 'basis'.
Source 'safty' kept verbatim; presumably a typo for 'safety'.
Source 'with pedant' kept verbatim; presumably a typo for 'pendant' (the table spells it 'Pendant').
Source 'anti overlap' kept verbatim; the intended check is unclear.
Rows 2.6 and 2.7 of the movements table both read 'ارفع للأسفل' (hoist down) in the source; rendered as 'Hoist down' in both rows.
'مساعد الرافعة' rendered as 'auxiliary hoist'; the rated-load line is an unfilled form field.
'التعيين' in the footer rendered as 'Assignment'; the intended field label is unclear.
The limit-switches table appears truncated in the source (only the 'Bridge limits' row survives); reproduced as-is.
